summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of the TankMesh BLE demo-mode Expo web preview. Verified overview, tank detail, per-tank settings, and app settings screens. 10/11 requested flows pass. One functional bug found: BLE status label on Overview shows 'IDLE' instead of 'BLE UNAVAILABLE' when demo-mode is off on web preview (BLE unavailable). All navigation, hydration, color-preset chip, and store writes work correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: When settings.demoMode=false but bleAvailable=false (web preview), header shows 'IDLE' instead of required 'BLE UNAVAILABLE'. The bleLabel ternary only covers demoMode=true; missing fallback for !state.bleAvailable case before bleStatus check. Screenshot shows 'IDLE · 4 tanks' even though 4 mock tanks are rendering because startDemo() was called by init() due to !ble.available. Requirement states label must be 'BLE UNAVAILABLE' or 'DEMO MODE' on web.
Uses Alert.alert('Saved', ...) after save — Alert.alert is a no-op on web (react-native-web); users get no confirmation on Expo web preview. Consider platform-conditional Toast or in-screen banner.

issues: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow". Comes from FAB shadow* style in app/tank/[mac]/index.tsx. Non-blocking but should migrate to boxShadow for RN Web / RN 0.76+.

action_items: Fix Overview BLE label logic in app/index.tsx: add `!state.bleAvailable ? 'BLE UNAVAILABLE'` branch BEFORE the bleStatus.toUpperCase fallback (or place it right after the demoMode check). Same fix needed in bleDotColor.
Replace Alert.alert in tank settings save() with a cross-platform toast/inline confirmation so web users see success feedback.
Migrate `shadow*` -> `boxShadow` in tank detail FAB styles to silence deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: tankStore.init() auto-starts demo mode when BLE is unavailable regardless of settings.demoMode value. This is intentional but the UI status label doesn't reflect the distinction — leading to misleading 'IDLE' label when running on web.
app/tank/[mac]/settings.tsx uses useEffect hydration flag correctly; prefill verified working (name='Fresh Water', hex='2AB7FF', order='0', group='TankMesh', sleep='60').
selectMatchingTanks filters strictly on t.mesh.prefix === screenGroupLabel — works as designed; when group label changes to 'OtherGroup' Overview correctly shows empty state.
seed_data_creation: None — demo-mode mock tanks generated by mockData.ts at runtime.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL from request works: https://aa7ece55-6bd4-4160-b3ed-9381ac630dc9.preview.emergentagent.com. Overview shows 4 demo tanks (Fresh Water, Grey Water, Black Water, Diesel) with correct colors and levels. All testIDs present and used. Playwright viewport 390x844. Verified flows: overview→tap tank→detail (78%)→FAB→per-tank settings (prefill correct)→color preset chip updates hex to 00C48C→Save all click succeeds (silently on web due to Alert.alert). Overview settings icon → app settings → change group label to 'OtherGroup' → Overview shows empty-state ✓ → restore 'TankMesh' → tanks reappear ✓. Demo toggle off/on cycle worked (tanks cleared then repopulated).
rca_of_issue: Overview BLE label bug RCA: In app/index.tsx line 28-35, the ternary chain begins `state.settings.demoMode ? 'DEMO MODE' : state.bleStatus === 'scanning' ? ...`. When demoMode is false AND bleAvailable is false (web preview default state), tankStore.init() still calls startDemo() (tankStore.ts line 58) but never sets bleStatus to a distinguishable value — it remains 'idle'. Consequently the label falls through to `state.bleStatus.toUpperCase()` = 'IDLE'. Fix: insert `!state.bleAvailable ? 'BLE UNAVAILABLE'` as the second branch (after demoMode check) in both bleLabel and bleDotColor. This preserves the requirement contract while not breaking real-device behaviour where bleAvailable=true.
